# govault_parameters (Data Source)

Read every GoVault parameter whose name starts with a prefix (all parameters when omitted). Paging is handled by the provider. Parameters are for **non-secret configuration** only. Their values are NOT sensitive: they appear in plan output and are stored in clear in Terraform state. Use the `govault_secret` ephemeral resource for secrets. Managing parameters from Terraform is not offered; this provider reads them only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every parameter whose name starts with "app/". Omit prefix to read them all.
# Values are non-secret and are stored in clear in Terraform state.
data "govault_parameters" "app" {
  prefix = "app/"
}

output "region" {
  value = data.govault_parameters.app.values["app/region"]
}

output "versions" {
  value = { for p in data.govault_parameters.app.parameters : p.name => p.version }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `prefix` (String) Only parameters whose name starts with this prefix, for example `app/`. The identity needs list access on it.

### Read-Only

- `parameters` (Attributes List) Details of each parameter, ordered by name. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--parameters))
- `values` (Map of String) Map of parameter name to current value. Not sensitive.

<a id="nestedatt--parameters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `parameters`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 UTC time the current version was created.
- `created_by` (String) Identity that wrote the current version; empty when not recorded.
- `description` (String) Description of the current version; empty when none.
- `name` (String) Parameter name.
- `revision` (String) Opaque revision identifier of the current version.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 UTC time the current version was last updated.
- `value` (String) Current value. Not sensitive.
- `version` (Number) Current version.
